purpose: Introduce build automation and error reporting for the fork.
current_reality: Repository lacked custom automation; now includes scripts to set up environment and compile.
user_input:
This will be a fork to build our own VSCode, 

* create a JGWILL_BUILD.sh that builds the whole package. 
* create JGWILL_SETUP.sh that install all the development environment (the cloned repository should be ready to build next) 
* JGWILL_BUILD.sh when failing should report all errors to a build text file that will be sent on errors using :  "coaia tash Workspace.jgwill.willcode:codex.local-build-failure-logs -F <build text file> -T 1000"  make sure the content of that file has everything for the agent to correct the issue
